Package io.github.jabrena.juno.robotics

@NullMarked package io.github.jabrena.juno.robotics
Board-independent motor contracts. DCMotor provides open-loop power control, Encoder provides position feedback, EncoderMotor combines the two, and RegulatedMotor adds encoder-backed speed and position control. Concrete adapters belong under the relevant board or device package and must preserve these primitive, allocation-free contracts.

    BaseMotor
    A motor that runs forward or backward until it is stopped.
    DCMotor
    A DC motor driven by a power level.
    Encoder
    Tachometer feedback for a motor or wheel, after leJOS's Encoder.
    EncoderMotor
    A motor with basic position feedback: open-loop power control from DCMotor and the position reported by Encoder.
    RegulatedMotor
    A motor with encoder feedback and closed-loop speed/position control.
